sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.

Morning debrief with Night Shift completed regarding the early-morning status of the CBD. They asked us to check in on the guard at Commercial Bay looking after the equipment while on routes there. Standing by to charge the Ops Phone, sitting at 26% (shown to camera).
Ops Phone at 70% (shown to camera); deploying onto routes now.
Commencing Alpha Route. Check-in at corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check on businesses along Queen Street towards Britomart Square, all clear:
Welfare check at Mecca, Dangerfield, the new Ippondo branch next to Dangerfield, Lush, the old NZ Muscles premises, 2degrees, all clear.
Welfare check on businesses within the Durham Street West alleyway vicinity, all clear:
Welfare check on businesses within the Durham Street East alleyway vicinity, all clear:
New EIKBEN by Mark'ne Limited branch next to TechPro
Welfare check and sweep through Vulcan Lane, all clear:
Welfare check and sweep through Imperial Lane, all clear.
Welfare check at Queens Arcade (still under renovation), all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the square, all clear. Art exhibitions ongoing in the square; welfare check with the guards monitoring the allocated art exhibition area, all clear.
77 Convenience Store corner of Commerce and Quay Street
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check and walkthrough of Wheirko Lane, Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy and Vape Shop, Nola Coffee, Ichiiban Japanese Restaurant, Round Six, JW Marriott, all clear.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, Elliott Street Apartment, Atrium on Elliott, Elliott Food Court, all clear.

Response message and call from Albert Mart Convenience Store to keep an eye out for an individual who stole a Topsy, last seen heading towards Mills Lane; picture sent through. We will look out for him during our routes. (Photo on file.)
Welfare check on stores along Wellesley Street West, all clear:
Tony's Original Steakhouse and Seafood Restaurant
Welfare check at Te Waihorotiu train station and walkthrough of the Bledisloe Building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, all clear. Ending Alpha Route here and commencing Delta Route.
Check-in at Skyworld Entertainment Centre; welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, Cafe and Bar, all clear.
Check-in at Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Queens Food Court and all restaurants within the vicinity
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Response call from Casa Victoria regarding two females at their outside tables who are not customers and need to be moved along.
While en route, received a call back advising they had already left, but to keep an eye out for them — one with blue hair, both in black attire; no pictures taken as the caller was busy.

Cut through to Victoria Street in case we could sight them and have a word regarding respecting establishments and staff requests. Posted up at the corner of Elliott Street and Victoria Street West scanning the area.
No sign of the individuals; resuming routes.
Response call from Mirrou regarding two female individuals who stole a pair of black shirts, last seen heading down towards Britomart.
Tracked all the way down to the Britomart lights with no sign of the individuals, until a bank guard advised they had boarded the Inner Link bus.
Crossed over; check-in at corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Walkthrough of Fort Lane; welfare check, all clear:
Imperial Lane entrance through Fort Lane
Mistry Shoe Repair and Key Cutting
Dilworth Building entrance Customs Street East
Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear; making our way to the last two check-ins for Delta.
Welfare check at Hoka, UGG Shoes, Haven Mart, North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check from Shortland Street towards Lorne Street, all clear:
Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Bentto, Choice Plaza, Sushiya, Choice Backpackers, Little Hanoi, Little Panda Takeaway Wellesley Street East, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear. Ending Delta Route here and commencing Echo Route.
Welfare check at NZ Muscles, Sal's Pizza, Titanic The Human Story, 77 Convenience Store, Subway, Bahn-Mi King, Hulucat, Avachi.

Welfare check interrupted — response call from Adidas Commercial Bay regarding a male individual intoxicated in public by the benches next to McDonald's; assistance requested to check if he is alright.
Arrived at the response call; a member of the public said the individual had wandered off towards Quay Street or Queens Wharf, disappearing into the heavy midday foot traffic.
Standing by to show presence and scanning the area in case the individual returns.
Leaving standby and recommencing routes. Check-in at Queens Arcade (still under renovation), all clear.
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:04)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Arrived at the office and was immediately approached by a member of the public asking for assistance.

The member of the public explained she had lost her side bag containing her driver's licence and bank cards. Assisted her by going into stores and asking whether a bag had been handed in, with no result. The last location she remembered having the bag was in front of the McDonald's Queen Street seating. Standing by for security presence. (Guard sent upstairs to sign the team in on the timesheets.)

Continuing to look out for the female's belongings — a lost red bag containing ID and bank cards. Her name (Silvia Grandi) and contact details have been recorded on file. Heading towards Elliott and Darby Street.
Darby and Elliott Street all clear; heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal and Victoria Street.
Received a call about a female behaving suspiciously inside Recycle Boutique; heading to the location now.
Arrived outside the store; standing by for security presence.
The POI has left the store and entered Celine; continuing to stand by for security presence. (Photo on file.)
Arrived at Headquarters, retrieving items before heading out to patrol.
Heading back on patrol, down towards Britomart via Queen Street.
Full sweep of Durham Street; welfare check at the corner of Durham, both Wilson Carparks, Midtown Mini Supermart and Hazy Tiger, all clear, no issues; continuing down Queen Street.
Full welfare checks from Mecca and Farmers through to Hallensteins and OPSM, all clear, no issues; commencing welfare checks on Wyndham Street.

Full sweep of Wyndham Street; welfare check at Chemist Warehouse, Pita Pit, QF Tavern, Japan Mart, Tokyo Liquor, Dingdong Lounge, Culprit Dining Room and Bar, Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues; standing by at Curio Bar.
Welfare check at Curio Bar, all clear, no issues; patrolling to Vulcan Lane.
Welfare check at JB Hi-Fi and its guards, all clear, no issues; arrived at Vulcan Lane, commencing sweep.

Full sweep of Vulcan Lane completed. Received a response call from Lovisa regarding an individual — not yet confirmed by staff — who walked out with another member of the public's backpack; en route to the location.

Arrived at Lovisa; approached by the member of the public whose bag was stolen. No description was available from her or staff; standing by for footage to be provided in order to potentially spot the thief in the area.
Standing down from Lovisa; patrolling up Durham Street East.
Durham East lane all clear, no issues; patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area (17:15–17:50).
Approached by a member of the public asking for help locating O Bar; escorted them to the location, all clear, no issues.
Approached by another member of the public advising that her belongings had been taken; assisting her in any way possible.
The member of the public has left the area; advised her to call the Police if further assistance is needed. Standing by in the area (18:34–18:45).
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, Chancery Square, O'Connell Street, Chancery Street and all businesses in the area, all clear, no issues; patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of High Street, no issues to report; arrived at Mothership, maintaining presence due to heavy public presence in the area.
Welfare check at Mothership, Shortland Mart, Taco Bell and Shortland Street, all clear.

Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check at Seoul Bar, KFC, Evans Kebab, Vape Haven, Haven Mart, The Right Track, Angus Steakhouse, Wilson Carpark, Mr Murdochs and The White Lady, all clear; standing by at Jo & Joes (19:20–19:35).
Welfare check at Jo & Joes; patrolling down Fort Street.

Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare check at Romania Italian Cuisine, Sal's Pizza, Tribe Hotel, Sienna, The Mermaid, Smiley Mart, Liquor K, El Mexican Zapata Cuisine, Char Grill and Asian Cuisine, all clear, no issues.
Received a call from management to make our way to Metropolis Avani to conduct a welfare check on the guard.
Arrived at Metropolis; conducting welfare check on the guard.
Welfare check on the guard completed; called management to confirm the guard's wellbeing, all clear, no issues. Standing by outside the front entrance.
Welfare check at Metropolis Avani all clear. Received a response call from Victoria Street News Agency regarding two vagrants outside drinking and causing a disturbance for customers.

Arrived at the location; both vagrants were no longer directly outside the premises, but staff pointed them out. Approached and asked them nicely not to shelter outside the store and to put the alcohol away; they complied, all clear, no issues. Standing by.

Received a call from 77 Convenience Store Queen Street regarding a male vagrant who left the store with stolen products, last seen going up Queen Street towards Elliott Street; heading down Queen Street to try to spot the vagrant described.
Received a call from a fellow guard to let him inside Level 7; advised him we would be a while due to the response call.
Elliott Street all clear, no vagrant matching the description seen in the area; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters, letting in the fellow guard and commencing our 30-minute break (21:05 on break).
Received a call from management to let them up to Level 7.
Letting up management, all clear. Received a call from Movenpick Hotel regarding a group of minors who had entered the premises with intent to break into cars; heading down to Movenpick.
Arrived at the location; no minors seen inside, but we have a good description of them — they are well known in the area — so we will patrol the area to potentially spot the described minors.
Still looking for the group of minors.
No sign of the POIs in the area. One guard has signed off heading to the next shift; the other is placed at Headquarters, heading there now.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:04 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (22:07–23:48).
Charging and gearing up completed; commencing patrols.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Celine's, all clear. Arrived at Bar 101, maintaining presence.

Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Received a response call from Harbour Suites from a fellow security guard regarding a male individual swearing, shouting and threatening the guard; en route to the location.
Received a call from management requesting we attend McDonald's Queen Street; notified management we are currently making our way to Harbour Suites for assistance first.

Arrived at the location; the male individual was not inside the site, but security had spotted him outside. Attempted to approach the individual, but he ran from the area with a non-working scooter; following the individual.
Removed alcohol from a female individual drinking in public, all clear.
After a lengthy search the individual has fled the area, no further issues; heading to McDonald's Queen Street as requested by management.
Arrived at the location; a security guard was posted outside, no issues. Called management to advise; standing by for any further issues.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear; patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check at Mothership, all clear, no issues; continuing down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear; arrived at Britomart.
Welfare check at Britomart, McDonald's and the Art Gallery, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check at Kemuri, all clear, no issues; continuing down Quay Street.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear, no issues; arrived at the Viaduct, commencing sweep of the area due to heavy public presence.
Full sweep of the Viaduct; welfare check at Lulas, Danny's, Rosie's and all guards, all clear, no issues.
Received a response call from QF Tavern regarding a group of male individuals inside the premises disturbing customers and refusing to leave the site; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; staff advised the group of individuals had fled the area. Retrieved photo footage of the POIs; standing by outside for any issues. (Footage on file.)
Welfare check at QF Tavern bar, all clear; patrolling up Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street, no issues; patrolling to Bar 101.
Full sweep of Darby Street, all clear, no issues to report; arrived at Bar 101, maintaining presence (03:00–03:35).
One guard going to Headquarters while the other stands by at Bar 101.
Guard has arrived back at Bar 101; maintaining presence.
Bar 101 has closed; standing by until the public crowd in the area clears out.
Crowd outside Bar 101 has cleared; commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check at Wilson Carpark and the hotdog stand, all clear, no issues; patrolling up Victoria Street.
Welfare check on Victoria Street and Skymart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Albert Street.
Arrived at Federal Square; commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare check at Indigo Hotel, the Cathedral and Liston House — no vagrants taking shelter, all clear.
Swanson Street West all clear, no issues to report; continuing down Albert Street.
Full sweep of the whole of Albert Street; welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues; arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing sweep of the area while maintaining presence (04:57–05:20).
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear; heading to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing 30-minute break while remaining available for any calls.
Break completed; standing by in the office awaiting guard handover.
Night Shift completed; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: CAPACITY: 00:15 Management request to attend McDonald's Queen Street was queued behind the active Harbour Suites threatening-male response; attended at 00:46.
CAPACITY: 20:40 Fellow guard's Level 7 access request delayed ~16 minutes while the team was engaged on the 77 Convenience Store theft response.
SENSITIVE: 00:06 Male individual swore at, shouted at and threatened a fellow security guard at Harbour Suites before fleeing; not located after search.
SENSITIVE: 14:45 Lost-property report — raw log records a member of the public's full name, phone number and email (kept to name-only in this JSON; details remain in the raw dump).

STALE: Afternoon Shift concluded and handed over at 22:04 rather than 22:30 (one guard signed off to next shift at 21:53); Night Shift log begins 22:07 — no coverage gap, but shift times differ from standard.
